Publish a metadata draft.

Panel: [Collection](/docs/reference/cli/panels/collection/).

## Usage

```text
huron publish [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

| Command                                     | Description                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`huron publish meta`](#huron-publish-meta) | Send the draft as a merge patch. The API writes `metadata.json` on the share. |

## `huron publish meta`

Send the draft as a merge patch. The API writes `metadata.json` on the share.

```text
huron publish meta [OPTIONS] [IDENTIFIER]
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                            |
| ------------ | ---- | -------------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | The default is the current collection. |
